name: @vssaros/dsh-media
description: VsSaros media-library module for DeepSeek Harness: a read-only self-hosted page (/x/media/) plus media_list / media_stats tools over the SAME `{rootDir}/media.db` that the VsSaros main-process MediaStore owns (bytes live at `{rootDir}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{id}.{ext}`, rootDir default `<dataRoot>/media`, overridable via `media-store-config.json`). Opens the database through Node's built-in `node:sqlite` (dsh requires Node 22.19+/24+, where it exists) in read-only mode: table creation and migrations stay single-writer on the VsSaros side, this module never creates or alters them.
